svg.title: How decode.py turns a denoised [8, 70] canvas into amino-acid and 3Di strings
svg.desc: decode_canvas_sample reads a continuous sample of shape [8, 70]. decode_embedding_tokens compares the six biochemical channels of every position by Euclidean distance (torch.cdist) with the 20 normalized amino-acid vectors, whose presence channel is 1, and with the all-zero PAD vector, and keeps the closest letter or PAD. nearest_foldseek_3di maps the two Foldseek coordinates of every position to the nearest of the 20 3Di centroids, IDs 1 to 20, and positions decoded as PAD become -. The 70-position decoded_canvas and predicted_3di_canvas are trimmed to generated and predicted_3di, and sequence_valid is true only when the residues form one nonempty block without internal PAD.
